summary.intent: Run UAT for phase 35 (Phala testnet TEE migration) to clear the last 6 remaining human-UAT verification debt items and bring total audit debt to zero.
summary.outcome: Phase 35 UAT was written, VERIFICATION.md flipped to passed, and committed — UAT audit debt is now zero across all phases (19.1, 21, and 35 all cleared).

repo: Staging API URL is https://api-staging.cipherbox.cc, exposed as GitHub environment variable STAGING_API_URL in the 'staging' environment.
The Phala Cloud CVM TEE endpoint referenced in phase 35 planning docs is stale — actual staging deployment runs tee-worker as a Docker container on the VPS, not on Phala.
ENVIRONMENTS.md contains stale Phala Cloud CVM references that no longer reflect actual staging infrastructure.
deploy-staging.yml provisions tee-worker as part of the VPS Docker Compose stack; Phala integration was planned for this phase but not shipped to staging.

UAT debt audit via `node .claude/gsd-core/bin/gsd-tools.cjs query audit-uat --raw` gives exact remaining item counts by phase and is the authoritative source — VERIFICATION.md item counts can diverge from what the audit actually tracks.

code.finding: Health controller exposes TEE worker connection status; used to verify whether staging API has a live TEE worker and what its epoch state is.
Staging deploy workflow shows tee-worker is a Docker container on the VPS — no Phala CVM provisioning step exists, confirming the Phala integration never shipped to staging.
initializeFromTee() validates epoch state against worker health on API boot; API startup behavior on TEE worker absence/failure was relevant to determining phase 35 item verdicts.

workflow: GitHub CLI `gh variable list --env <env>` paginates at 10 results by default — always pass `--limit 100` or explicitly check for truncation when listing environment variables.

When verifying a cloud integration that was planned but may not have shipped, cross-check deploy workflow YAML and direct port probes rather than relying on planning or architecture docs, which can be aspirational.
UAT debt audit should be re-run after each phase completion to confirm the count drops as expected — it is the ground truth, not VERIFICATION.md item counts.

friction: GitHub variables list hit the default 10-item page cap on the first query, silently truncating results and requiring a second paginated call to find STAGING_API_URL.
Phase 35 VERIFICATION.md listed only 2 human items while the audit reported 6 — required checking raw audit output to understand actual scope before starting.

Had to triangulate across health endpoint probe, direct VPS port probe, deploy workflow YAML, and deploy run logs to confirm that Phala CVM was never actually used in staging; planning docs were misleading about the deployed state.
open_items: Push branch `fix/pinning-provider-fetch-binding` and open a PR — offered earlier but superseded by UAT work; still pending.

Three diagnosed phase-21 gaps need fixes: missing PATCH /vault/byo-status call in web save flow (major); MigrationProgress polling never restarts after a terminal job (minor); migration stats double-count due to API 120s batch timeout vs >130s worker batches (minor). Addressable via `/gsd-plan-phase 21 --gaps`.
User must manually persist TEE_WORKER_URL=http://localhost:3002 and TEE_WORKER_SECRET (in /tmp/cipherbox-tee-secret.txt) into apps/api/.env — Claude cannot touch .env files.
Stale Phala Cloud CVM references in ENVIRONMENTS.md should be updated to reflect the actual VPS Docker Compose deployment.
Local TEE worker setup (Docker on port 3002, secret in /tmp/) is ephemeral and will need to be re-established in future sessions if the TEE-dependent features need further work.
